name: chown
description: Change the user and optionally the group ownership of each FILE.

options.description: Operate on files and directories recursively.
Use the owner and group of RFILE.

examples.title: Assign a web directory to its service account
examples.explanation: Transfers ownership of the document root to the web service account.

examples.title: Change only the owner
examples.explanation: Changes the user owner while retaining the existing group.

examples.title: Change only the group
examples.explanation: Assigns the file to the developers group without changing its owner.

warnings: changing ownership on system paths usually requires root; recursive changes (chown -R) are hard to revert once service accounts are reassigned.
